text: δίδωσιν ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὰ νομίσματα τῷ Ἐμπόρῳ καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
artist_notes: Hands and coins centered over the table; keep eye-lines clear.
positioning: Dinosaur extends his right hand forward over the stall, three-quarter view, looking at Emporos while offering the coins.
Emporos reaches out with open palm to receive the coins, front view, watching the payment.
The small woven sack dangles closed from Dinosaur’s left hand at his side.
The five bright silver coins rest across Dinosaur’s outstretched fingers mid-transfer over the table.
The merchant’s stall table stays between them, edge aligned with their hands.
The round rustic loaf remains within reach at the table’s front.
The basket of red apples sits to the side, slightly behind the loaf.
The tall clay water jar stands near the back corner of the table.
